description: This file contains Python functions related to data extraction and processing for the Opik payload building within the litellm project. It includes functions for normalizing provider names, extracting metadata, span identifiers, tags, and applying header overrides to configure context-specific parameters.

methods.name: Optional[str] normalize_provider_name(provider: Optional[str])
methods.description: Normalizes internal provider names to standard string names used in Opik, with optional mapping.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] extract_opik_metadata( litellm_metadata: Dict[str, Any], standard_logging_metadata: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Merges Opik-specific metadata from litellm and standard logging structures.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] extract_span_identifiers( current_span_data: Any, )
methods.description: Extracts trace_id and parent_span_id from a given span data structure.

methods.name: List[str] extract_tags( opik_metadata: Dict[str, Any], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Builds a list of tags from metadata and optional provider info.

methods.name: Tuple[str,List[str],Optional[str]] apply_proxy_header_overrides( project_name: str, tags: List[str], thread_id: Optional[str], proxy_headers: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Overrides project, thread, and tags based on proxy headers with 'opik_' prefix.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] extract_and_build_metadata( opik_metadata: Dict[str, Any], standard_logging_metadata: Dict[str, Any], standard_logging_object: Dict[str, Any], litellm_kwargs: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Constructs a comprehensive metadata dictionary by combining multiple sources including Opik, logging, cost, and debug info.

ctags.signature: ( litellm_metadata: Dict[str, Any], standard_logging_metadata: Dict[str, Any], )
